================================================================================
missing semicolon before a closing brace is still an error
:error
================================================================================

a { b 1 }

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------



================================================================================
unclosed block is still an error
:error
================================================================================

a { b 1;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------



================================================================================
unterminated eval body is still an error
:error
================================================================================

a #eval{ 1 + ;
b 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------



================================================================================
unterminated verbatim is still an error
:error
================================================================================

code #{ int x;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
